about: One archived bot, Waffle (made through the API). Settings > Advanced features > Archived bots (opened from its row with the keyboard focus on it), then Escape. The element that has focus afterwards is outlined in red by the capture (an eval step); when focus has fallen to the page body, the whole page is outlined.

steps.eval: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; const target = a && a !== document.body ? a : document.querySelector('#root'); target.style.setProperty('outline', '3px solid #ff3b30', 'important'); target.style.setProperty('outline-offset', a && a !== document.body ? '2px' : '-3px', 'important'); return a === document.body ? 'body' : (a.getAttribute('aria-label') || a.textContent).trim().slice(0, 60); })()
